purpose: Separate a VS Code host webview failure from xMind webview code.

observations: xMind sidebar reported ServiceWorker registration InvalidStateError.
VS Code built-in Markdown preview reported the same ServiceWorker registration InvalidStateError.
A full VS Code app exit and relaunch did not clear the failure.
xMind also reported that its owned local backend exited before readiness; the profile and database were preserved.

fresh_user_data_test.check: VS Code built-in Markdown: Open Preview
fresh_user_data_test.observation: Markdown rendered in the preview webview without a service-worker error.

limits: The fresh-profile check validates only the built-in Markdown preview, not the xMind extension or coding flow.
The default VS Code profile cache was not moved or deleted because other Code processes were still running.
The xMind native backend startup failure remains a separate unresolved issue.
